tropical_outlook: No tropical threat to any Week 10 venue. Atlantic: a gale-force non-tropical low (Invest 94L) a few hundred miles south of Bermuda was reported on Nov 9 with NHC odds of 20% (48h) / 30% (7d) of becoming a subtropical/tropical storm (would be named Kyle); it is moving east over the open subtropical Atlantic, upper-level winds turn unfavorable by late weekend, and no land threat is indicated. A cached NHC page snippet from Nov 9 instead read 'formation not expected in 7 days', so the exact odds are unconfirmed but low either way. Eastern Pacific: no cyclones. Central Pacific: Tropical Storm Pena (45 mph) south-southwest of Hawaii, irrelevant to NFL venues. Note: Thursday's rain in NJ/MD is a non-tropical frontal system followed by the coldest air of the season.

2026_10_NE_DET.notes: INTERNATIONAL/NEUTRAL VENUE. No wind figure was found; 6 mph is a climatological placeholder. Kickoff 09:30 ET = 15:30 CET, sunset about 16:35 CET, so temperature falls during the game.
